result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a persistent loading spinner remains visible over an already-loaded restaurant card image.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner overlay is stuck in the center of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' image under the 'Popular right now' section, even though the image and card content have already finished loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading indicator state is properly cleared and hidden once the image asset or card data finishes loading.
